en_title: The Witcher 3 Remastered Has Already Broken Steam Concurrent Player Record
subtitle: 热度还在上涨
opus_summary: 《巫师3：狂猎-重制版》上线数小时便创下Steam同时在线人数新高，达到114,696人，超过2020年的103,329人。该数据尚未计入XBOX Series、PS5、Switch 2及其他PC平台玩家。

paragraphs.en: We're just a few hours into the launch of The Witcher 3 Remastered , and it's already beaten its previous record for concurrent players on Steam.
paragraphs.cn: 《巫师3：狂猎-重制版》上线仅数小时，就已经打破了游戏此前在Steam上的同时在线人数纪录。

paragraphs.en: Before the remaster came out, Steam's previous player peak for the 11-year-old The Witcher 3 came in January 2020, when the Witcher TV series came out. Back then, 103,329 people were all playing The Witcher 3 at the same time on Valve's platform, according to SteamDB . Now that the remaster is here, The Witcher 3 has reached a new peak of 114,696 players, a massive 258% jump from last month, where 31,959 people were playing. Keep in mind, though, that this only takes Steam players into account, there are likely a huge amount of people playing on Xbox Series X and S , PS5 , Nintendo Switch 2, and on other PC platforms such as GoG and Battle.net.
paragraphs.cn: 在重制版推出前，《巫师3》这款已经问世11年的游戏曾于2020年1月创下Steam同时在线人数峰值，当时正值《巫师》电视剧开播。据SteamDB统计，当时共有103,329名玩家同时在Valve平台游玩《巫师3》。如今，重制版已经推出，游戏又创下了114,696人的新峰值，相比上个月31,959人的同时在线人数大涨258%。不过请注意，这一数据只统计了Steam玩家，XBOX Series、PS5、任天堂的Switch 2，以及GoG和Battle.net等其他PC平台上可能还有大量玩家。

paragraphs.en: These numbers will likely go up throughout the week, too. As we head into the weekend, people will have more time to jump into the game, and because it's a free update for anyone who already owns The Witcher 3, there's a low barrier to entry – as long as you have a decent gaming PC . The game has also had some growing pains, where it wasn't working properly on AMD graphics cards at launch, though that issue has been fixed with an AMD graphics driver .
paragraphs.cn: 本周内，这一数字可能还会继续上涨。随着周末临近，玩家将有更多时间投入游戏；对于已经拥有《巫师3》的玩家来说，重制版是免费更新，只要拥有一台性能尚可的游戏PC，入门门槛并不高。游戏发售时也经历了一些问题，AMD显卡无法正常运行游戏，不过该问题已经通过AMD显卡驱动得到修复。

paragraphs.en: It's not hard to see why people are flocking to the Witcher 3 Remastered. CD Projekt Red has worked in a whole laundry list of improvements to everything from the graphics to Roach's running animations. The game even works in path tracing, but for that you're going to want an absolute beast of a gaming PC.
paragraphs.cn: 玩家纷纷涌向《巫师3：狂猎-重制版》的原因并不难理解。CDPR为游戏加入了大量改进，涉及画面、萝卜的奔跑动画等诸多方面。游戏甚至支持路径追踪，不过想要开启这项功能，你需要一台性能极其强悍的游戏PC。

paragraphs.en: To ease you into Geralt’s life on the road, check out the things The Witcher 3 doesn’t tell you , plus IGN’s The Witcher 3 walkthrough and The Witcher 3 endings guide, which outlines all of the major quests and choices in the base game and expansions (now bundled in with the Remastered edition). When you’re ready for the tough choices, check out our The Witcher 3 sex and romance guide to see who Geralt can smooch and all the opportunities to do so. And to make Geralt as strong a monster hunter as possible, check out all the Witcher gear locations , Places of Power locations , and even Gwent card locations .
paragraphs.cn: 如果你想更快熟悉杰洛特的旅途生活，可以看看《巫师3》没有告诉你的那些事，以及IGN的《巫师3》流程攻略和结局攻略，后者梳理了本体及扩展内容中的所有主要任务与关键选择，这些内容如今都已包含在重制版中。准备面对艰难抉择时，还可以参考《巫师3》性爱与恋爱攻略，了解杰洛特能够亲吻哪些角色，以及所有相关机会。想让杰洛特成为尽可能强大的猎魔人，则可以查看全部猎魔装备、能量之所和昆特牌的位置。
